protocol.design: 24 cases fixed before simulation: midday trend, midday reversal near completed morning extreme, afternoon trend aligned with session direction; both/long-only; 2/3 times prior completed 12-bar true-range mean stops; 1.5R/2R targets; one NQ contract. Midday entry at 12:00, afternoon entry 14:00; flatten 15:55. One attempt per session; no missing candles invented.
protocol.selection: Same three chronological training blocks and qualification as earlier session batch: positive each block, >=60 trades each, no risk shutdown, closing/intrabar DD <20000 NQ dollars in base and 2x costs. Top four frozen by base training rank before 2x replay. Select one passing survivor; otherwise none. No validation/test access or variants in this driver.
protocol.limitations: Repeated in-training hypothesis search; the researcher retains prior results, so this is not clean external confirmation. NQ mini economics and 10x risk budgets are not historical MNQ P&L. Block capital/risk resets prevent interpreting sums as a full-history continuous account.

uncertainty.method: Circular session block bootstrap; weak stationarity assumed; not future probability
